Show how inferred states acquire an ecological interpretation

Source: R/state-display.R
plot_ssf_states.Rd

Combines a labelled state table, a track, observed movement distributions and coefficient intervals. The distributions group the observations by their Viterbi labels; they are descriptive, not independent validation. The overview uses one common state legend. The same colours are used throughout. Coefficient intervals condition on the fitted model and labels and do not adjust for model or taxonomy selection.

Usage

plot_ssf_states(
  x,
  panel = c("overview", "table", "track", "distributions", "coefficients", "contrasts"),
  step_scale = 1,
  step_unit = "input units",
  segment = NULL,
  step_range = NULL,
  coords = c("x0", "y0", "x", "y"),
  terms = NULL,
  assessment = NULL,
  coord_unit = "input units",
  colours = NULL,
  term_labels = NULL,
  angle_bandwidth = 0.35,
  comparisons = NULL
)

Arguments

x

A fitted ssf_fit or selected guided_ssf object.

panel

"overview" combines the views. Use "table", "track", "distributions", "coefficients" or "contrasts" to draw them separately.

step_scale

Positive multiplier applied to step lengths and their SDs. For input in kilometres, use 1000 to display metres.

step_unit

Label for the resulting distance unit. Units are not inferred.

segment, step_range, coords

Passed to plot.ssf_fit() for the map only. All other panels use the complete fitted observations.

terms

Optional coefficient names for the coefficient or contrast panel. The default shows target, environmental and context effects, including interactions, but excludes baseline distance parameters and cos_angle. Movement distributions already describe those baseline terms. Supply explicit names to inspect them. An overview omits its coefficient panel when there are no additional covariate effects.

assessment

Optional accepted assessment from assess_taxonomy() for this fitted model. This makes a post-fit ecological interpretation visible without fitting the model again.

coord_unit

Unit label for the original map coordinates. Coordinates are not rescaled by step_scale.

colours

Optional colour vector, named by state label or in fitted state order. This can keep the same ecological colours across models.

term_labels

Optional named character vector of readable coefficient names, indexed by the names in terms.

angle_bandwidth

Circular smoothing bandwidth in radians, shared by all states. The default is 0.35 (about 20 degrees).

comparisons

Optional from/to state pairs for the contrast panel; see ssf_state_contrasts().

Value

A ggplot object, or a patchwork for combined views. ggplot2 is required; combined views also require patchwork. The turning-angle panel requires ggcircular. Missing observations or covariance are identified in the relevant panel. For an overview with four covariates, export at about 12 by 10 inches; add height for more states or covariates.
